EX-99.1 2 amlx-ex99_1.htm EX-99.1 EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Amylyx Pharmaceuticals Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results • Reported positive topline results from Phase 3 LUCIDITY clinical trial of avexitide in post-bariatric hypoglycemia; New Drug Application submission planned by end of 2026 remains on track • Results from LUCIDITY trial accepted as a late-breaking oral presentation at ObesityWeek® 2026 Annual Meeting on November 15 • Strengthened balance sheet through upsized public offering with net proceeds of approximately $545 million • Management to host conference call and webcast today at 8:00 a.m.

“The third quarter was a transformational period for Amylyx, as we reported positive topline results from the Phase 3 LUCIDITY trial of avexitide in post-bariatric hypoglycemia, bringing us one step closer to potentially delivering a first ever FDA-approved treatment to people living with PBH,” said Joshua Cohen and Justin Klee, Co-CEOs of Amylyx.
We remain on track to submit our NDA by year-end and are executing on our comprehensive commercial readiness plans ahead of a potential launch of avexitide in 2027, if approved.

With a strengthened balance sheet following our recent equity financing, we believe we are well positioned to deliver on our commitment to bring meaningful new treatments to people living with diseases with high unmet needs.” Third Quarter and Recent Updates: • Amylyx reported positive topline results from Phase 3 LUCIDITY clinical trial of avexitide in participants with post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH) following Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) surgery.

Such statements include, but are not limited to, Amylyx’s expectations regarding: the therapeutic potential of avexitide as a treatment for PBH; the timing for the submission of an NDA for avexitide in PBH; the timing for presentation of LUCIDITY data at an upcoming conference; Amylyx’s commercial readiness plans; the timing for potential commercialization of avexitide, if approved; the therapeutic potential of AMX0114 as a treatment for ALS; the expected enrollment and progress of the LUMINA trial; the therapeutic potential of AMX0318 and the expected timeline for a potential IND submission; the potential benefits of expedited program and orphan designations held by Amylyx; the potential benefits of the research collaborations with Gubra A/S; and financial performance, cash runway, including the sufficiency of Amylyx’s capital resources to support commercialization of avexitide, if approved, and longer-term strategy.
